assets.name: Li Jie
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-1 · 文件页 31 / 印刷页 24

source_visual_review.design: Adult animal doctor Li Jie in lower section, short neat black hair, white knee-length lab coat over pale blue shirt, dark gray trousers and brown shoes, small gray stethoscope resting close around neck. Empty hands, no clipboard and no animals.

assets.reason: 兽医 Li Jie 的白大褂与听诊器补齐医疗职业轮廓；可作为后续医疗服装的制作起点。

assets.name: Mr Wang
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-2 · 文件页 36 / 印刷页 29

source_visual_review.design: Adult street cleaner Mr Wang, orange peaked work cap, orange coverall with yellow reflective bands across chest, sleeves and trouser knees, dark work shoes. Short black hair and friendly mature face as shown in lower close-up. No broom, mask or street background.

assets.reason: 环卫工人 Mr Wang 的反光工装和工作帽形成独立职业造型；教材身份为环卫工人。

assets.name: Mr Chen
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-2 · 文件页 36 / 印刷页 29

source_visual_review.design: Adult traffic officer Mr Chen on duty in middle-left panel; white peaked cap with navy band and simple abstract badge, pale blue shirt, navy tie, fluorescent yellow reflective vest with broad white bands, navy trousers, white gloves, black shoes. No weapon or road scene.
source_visual_review.constraints: No readable lettering or official insignia text; preserve main uniform color blocking.

assets.reason: 交警 Mr Chen 的制帽、反光背心和手套与既有人物服装差异明确。

assets.name: Miss Lin
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-2 · 文件页 36 / 印刷页 29

source_visual_review.design: Adult station attendant Miss Lin, identified in top-right panel assisting a passenger; neat low black hair bun, white long-sleeve blouse, charcoal navy vest and matching straight trousers, compact pink-and-white neck scarf, low black work shoes. Empty hands; no passenger, wheelchair or train.

assets.reason: 车站服务员 Miss Lin 提供成人女性制服造型，适用于问路、帮助乘客的教材情境。

assets.name: Wang Yaping
assets.source_label: english-grade5-volume1-smartedu-2022 · 文件页 11 / 印刷页 4

source_visual_review.design: Wang Yaping from the small named astronaut photo at lower right. Adult female astronaut with long black hair pulled neatly back, expressive warm mature face, white-blue spacesuit with a broad gold-toned neck collar ring, blue side bands, white gloves and space boots. No helmet covering the face, no text, logos or flags.
source_visual_review.constraints: Stylized full-body completion based on portrait; preserve adult proportions. Not the pink-dress teacher above.

assets.reason: 王亚平的成人宇航服带有明显的颈环、关节和手套结构；其他成人航天服可从这套服装派生。

assets.name: Lingling 的母亲
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 28 / 印刷页 21

source_visual_review.design: Lingling's mother in family scene: adult Chinese woman with short black bob curved inward at jaw, dark pink headband, pink long-sleeve calf-length dress with narrow belt, soft pink flats. Kind mature mother face.
source_visual_review.constraints: Remove shoulder handbag. Empty hands. Preserve adult proportions and pink clothes.

assets.reason: 玲玲母亲的成年比例与日常长裙用于三上家庭介绍；也可作为其他母亲角色的身体、裙装起点。

assets.name: Lingling 的父亲
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 28 / 印刷页 21

source_visual_review.design: Lingling's father in family scene: tall slim adult Chinese man, short black side-parted hair, light lavender V-neck pullover over white collared shirt, deep blue trousers and slate-gray white shoes. Friendly mature face.
source_visual_review.constraints: No child or camera; standing A pose, empty hands.

assets.reason: 玲玲父亲的成年比例与日常针织衫用于三上家庭介绍；能减少后来普通成年男性的独立建模。

assets.name: Uncle Ben
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 31 / 印刷页 24

source_visual_review.design: Adult Uncle Ben in park, swept dark red hair, white long-sleeved collared shirt under royal blue V-neck sweater vest, charcoal gray trousers, muted brown shoes. Empty hands, no newspaper.

assets.reason: Uncle Ben 的红棕发、衬衫与背心补充另一种成年男性造型，并与家庭成员同场使用。

assets.name: Aunt Carol
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 31 / 印刷页 24

source_visual_review.design: Adult Aunt Carol in park, long wavy brown hair, white blouse with modest round collar, purple below-knee skirt, white flats. Hands empty, no book.

assets.reason: Aunt Carol 的长卷发和衬衫长裙提供另一种成年女性轮廓，避免家庭场景所有母亲同形。

assets.name: Lily
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 31 / 印刷页 24

source_visual_review.design: Child Lily as introduced in third panel, light brown high ponytail and short parted fringe, pale pink long-sleeved dress with a darker pink flower applique at waist, white socks and pink shoes. No skipping rope. Very similar face/clothes to cousin Lucy; preserve source resemblance.
source_visual_review.constraints: Only one child.

assets.reason: Lily 与 Lucy 的参考图几乎同形；只生成 Lily，另一位保留独立身份并复用网格。

assets.name: Amy
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g5-2 · 文件页 34 / 印刷页 27

source_visual_review.design: Amy in Mother's Day dialogue. No illustration on source page. Original schoolgirl design: warm medium brown skin, dark curly hair in two short round puffs, pale yellow short-sleeve shirt under teal dungaree dress, cream socks and mustard sneakers. Warm helpful expression.
source_visual_review.constraints: Entire appearance is original game design; preserve school-age role, no fan or cards.

assets.reason: Amy 的卷发双髻、背带裙和肤色组合补充现有儿童造型；可作为 Cindy、Fran 等改装的身体起点。

assets.name: Dan
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-1 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Dan, kind school-aged boy in New York subway story; no portrait on page. Original game design: warm medium-brown skin, short dark curly hair, denim-blue zip hoodie over cream T-shirt, olive trousers, white sneakers with blue details. Friendly young face.
source_visual_review.constraints: Original appearance, empty hands, no tickets or subway.

assets.reason: Dan 的紧卷短发与连帽外套补充另一种儿童轮廓；Benson 等可复用身体后更换服装。

assets.name: Doggie
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 21 / 印刷页 14

source_visual_review.design: Golden tan floppy-eared pet dog with darker brown ear tips, cream muzzle and belly, dark brown fitted chest harness with small red fitting; friendly rounded muzzle. Natural four-legged standing stance, all paws visible, gently curved full tail. No leash, clothes, person or upright human torso.

assets.reason: Doggie 是自然四足犬；已有的站立动物居民无法直接提供这种身体结构和行走方式。

assets.name: Kitty
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-1 · 文件页 26 / 印刷页 19

source_visual_review.design: Kitty, Binbin's ordinary orange pet cat in lower-right panel, orange tabby fur with broad dark orange stripes, white muzzle, belly, paws and tail tip, pointy ears and curved tail. Four-legged standing stance, no clothing, no fish or bowl.

assets.reason: Kitty 是自然四足短毛猫；与拟人美术老师彩彩分开制作，可承接白猫毛色变体。

assets.name: Elephant Ella
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-1 · 文件页 36 / 印刷页 29

source_visual_review.design: Elephant Ella is the SMALL calf beside her mother at bottom: soft light bluish-gray skin, oversized pink inner ears, tiny head tuft, short curved trunk, four round legs with toenails, thin tail with tuft; no tusks or clothes. Exactly one calf standing in natural quadruped stance, trunk gently lowered away from paws.

assets.reason: Elephant Ella 补齐象鼻、大耳与粗壮四肢，已有模型中没有相近体型。

assets.name: Fendi
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-1 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Fendi, little orange clownfish in illustrated story, bright orange body, three broad white bands with thin dark outlines, rounded fins and fan tail, friendly large eye. Entire fish in gentle side three-quarter view so bands and tail visible, suspended against white, no water, tank, bird, plants, limbs or clothes.
source_visual_review.constraints: Fish anatomy only; no arms, legs or standing ground pose.

assets.reason: Fendi 补齐鱼体、鳍和尾部结构；适合水中故事与观察活动。

assets.name: Qinmou
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-2 · 文件页 74 / 印刷页 67

source_visual_review.design: Qinmou, little golden monkey in story; orange-gold sculpted fur, pale cream chest and cheeks, soft light bluish-gray central face, short rounded muzzle, small round ears, long curling tail. Young small monkey with four primate limbs, no human clothes or human feet.
source_visual_review.constraints: Standing lightly crouched monkey pose with forelimbs apart from torso, entire curved tail visible; no branches, fruit or additional monkeys.

assets.reason: Qinmou 是自然姿态的金丝猴，与穿衣直立的鼓鼓体型和支撑方式有明显差异。

assets.name: Bunny
assets.source_label: english-grade5-volume1-smartedu-2022 · 文件页 33 / 印刷页 26

source_visual_review.design: Small ordinary white pet rabbit named Bunny, long upright ears with light pink inner ears, compact rabbit body and soft rounded paws, tiny white tail, dark friendly eyes and pink nose. Natural seated rabbit stance, all limbs apparent, no clothing or cage.

assets.reason: Bunny 是自然兔，保留后腿、长耳与四足结构；与穿衣的兔兔园丁分别处理。

assets.name: Nian
assets.source_label: english-grade5-volume1-smartedu-2022 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Nian, orange-red mythical quadruped from middle-right story picture. Long curling orange tail ending in red flame-shaped tuft, broad orange feline-dragon face, red mane/back accents, stout four paws with cream claws, large expressive eyes and a few small ivory teeth visible in friendly closed smile. Soft sculpted forms, calm stance, entire tail and paws visible.
source_visual_review.constraints: Make a child-friendly calm creature from source monster, preserve orange/red color and long curled tail. No attacks, firecrackers, people, lanterns or lettering.

assets.reason: 年兽的角、鬃毛、尾巴和四足轮廓独特，适合节庆故事。

assets.name: Baker
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-1 · 文件页 55 / 印刷页 48

source_visual_review.design: Baker is middle-sized of the three LARGE forest singers. Game mapping uses upper middle gray-black and white bird: rounded white breast and belly, charcoal wings and tail, light gray head with short dark crest, faint pink cheek, golden beak and feet. Two folded wings, two feet visible, entire tail, no branch or clothing.
source_visual_review.constraints: Bird names aren't individually labeled; color mapping is game interpretation. Intended model height 0.50 m; Bob < Baker < Ben.

assets.reason: Baker 作为六只大小比较鸟的基础网格；其他五只先以缩放、羽色及少量冠羽/尾羽调整派生。

assets.name: Kelly
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-2 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Kelly is the white adult mother dog above three puppies. Slender long-legged white dog, rounded floppy ears with subtle pale-blue shadow, long muzzle with dark rosy nose, friendly dark eyes, long gently curved tail. Pink collar with simple pink heart pendant. Natural standing four-legged pose, all four paws and entire tail.
source_visual_review.constraints: Only mother dog, no puppies, no kennel or ball. Adult animal, no human clothes.

assets.reason: Kelly 是细长四肢的成年母犬；犬妈妈与圆头短身幼犬同场时需要不同的身体比例。

assets.name: Kathy
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-2 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Kathy, white puppy at lower left in dog family. Small all-white puppy with floppy triangular ears, rounded muzzle, soft dark pink nose, playful dark eyes, white tapering tail. Simplified light-blue collar with compact bow. Natural four-legged standing pose.
source_visual_review.constraints: Stand instead of rolling on back, no ball, no siblings. Entire puppy and paws visible.

assets.reason: Kathy 作为三只幼犬的共同网格；Kent、Karen 通过黑色和斑点贴图、领结色区分。

assets.name: Xiaoxiao 的鹦鹉
assets.source_label: english-grade5-volume1-smartedu-2022 · 文件页 36 / 印刷页 29

source_visual_review.design: Xiaoxiao's unnamed talking parrot at center: natural green parrot with red-orange forehead and face, cream curved beak, yellow-green long tapered tail, darker emerald folded wings with sculpted feather ridges, gray feet. Gentle three-quarter standing bird with two visible feet, full tail.
source_visual_review.constraints: No cage, ring, bell, perch or people. It repeats Haohao's name but is NOT named Haohao.

assets.reason: 鹦鹉的弯喙、长尾与足部抓握结构区别于比较大小的小鸟，单独保留。

assets.name: Robbie
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 41 / 印刷页 34

source_visual_review.design: Small friendly humanoid robot Robbie, white round helmet-like head, charcoal circular face panel with two large cyan eyes and small cyan smile; white smooth segmented shell, cyan joint accents, short gray mechanical neck and abdomen, two arms and two legs, dark simplified robot hands, rounded broad white feet. No ears, fur or clothes.

assets.reason: Robbie 提供独立机械关节与外壳造型；玩具机器人可考虑用其简化版本。

assets.name: Confucius
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-2 · 文件页 69 / 印刷页 62

source_visual_review.design: Confucius, inspired by labeled standing statue upper left: elderly scholar with topknot, long gray beard and moustache, layered wide-sleeve traditional Chinese scholar robe with crossed front and broad sash. Translate stone depiction into living stylized story actor; muted warm tan robe with dark brown trim and shoes, warm natural skin. Separate hands and sleeve edges, no pedestal or statue material.
source_visual_review.constraints: Full-body standing actor; this is an interpretive game palette, not a claimed historical costume-color reconstruction.

assets.reason: 孔子的长须、古代学者长袍和发髻提供老年文士造型；作为后续相关故事服装的基础。

assets.name: Qu Yuan
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g4-2 · 文件页 58 / 印刷页 51

source_visual_review.design: Qu Yuan commemorated by festival text, no portrait on source page. Original respectful story-actor interpretation of ancient Chinese adult poet: dark hair in tall tied topknot, narrow black moustache and beard, long muted teal cross-collar robe over cream inner layer, warm tan sash, brown soft shoes. Mature thoughtful face, empty hands.
source_visual_review.constraints: Historical story costume and palette are artistic adaptation; no claim of exact historical likeness. No dragon boat or food.

assets.reason: 屈原提供较清瘦的成年古装长袍造型，与老年孔子和儿童古装区分。

assets.name: Zhang Heng
assets.source_label: english-grade5-volume1-smartedu-2022 · 文件页 56 / 印刷页 49

source_visual_review.design: Little Zhang Heng in lower-right star-watching illustration, CHILD not adult scholar: mostly shaved head with small black top tuft and tied side/back locks, blue cross-collar robe with darker trim and tan sash, blue trousers and dark cloth shoes. Round curious child face, empty hands. No stars, grandfather or rock.
source_visual_review.constraints: This is the childhood story portrayal; do not copy elder in brown.

assets.reason: 这里的张衡是幼年形象；儿童交领短袍和发式可用于后续古代儿童服装改装。

assets.name: Yu Gong
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g5-2 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Yu Gong, elderly man at right in lower scene, thin gray-white hair tied at back, white moustache and pointed beard, visibly wrinkled kind face, light blue short-sleeve cross-collar tunic with dark blue trim and brown sash, dark olive knee-length trousers and woven straw sandals. Empty hands and planted feet.
source_visual_review.constraints: Remove hoe/tool; retain elder age and work clothes.

assets.reason: 愚公的瘦长老年体型、短袖短裤和草鞋区别于文士长袍，保留劳动场景造型。

assets.name: Jade Emperor
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g5-2 · 文件页 73 / 印刷页 66

source_visual_review.design: Jade Emperor named in final paragraph, no picture of him. Original gentle celestial emperor story actor: mature East Asian man with long dark beard and moustache, gold and jade-green ceremonial crown with compact flat top and short pearl strands kept away from face, pale jade-green long robe with broad golden collar/cuffs and simple cloud motifs, cream inner layer, dark green shoes.
source_visual_review.constraints: Artistic mythological costume, not source-verified likeness. Avoid excessive hanging ornaments; empty hands, no throne or cloud pedestal.

assets.reason: 玉皇大帝提供冠冕、礼服和宽袍结构，可作为其他古代君主服装的起点。

assets.name: Chang'e
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-1 · 文件页 22 / 印刷页 15

source_visual_review.design: Chang'e from lower-right moon illustration: graceful ADULT woman with long black hair, high looped bun and small pink flowers, soft mature face, pale white wide-sleeve blouse under pink/lavender vest with mint edging, long layered purple-and-white skirt, light green sash, pale embroidered shoes. Two restrained pink ribbons descend along sides without covering hands or body silhouette.
source_visual_review.constraints: Standing full-body A-pose from flying source; remove rabbit, moon and floating ribbons, keep ribbons attached and compact. No child proportions.

assets.reason: 嫦娥的宽袖、长裙和飘带轮廓独特，现有日常女性服装难以直接派生。

assets.name: Santa Claus
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g6-1 · 文件页 63 / 印刷页 56

source_visual_review.design: Santa Claus shown in panel3 thought bubble, an elderly plump man with white eyebrows, long full white beard and curled moustache, red conical hat with white trim and pompom, red jacket and trousers with fluffy white trim, black belt with gold buckle and black boots. White gloves, empty hands.
source_visual_review.constraints: Remove all gifts, sack and children. Traditional friendly holiday story actor, complete feet.

assets.reason: 圣诞老人的圆润体型、胡须、红衣与靴子形成完整节庆造型；可复用帽子配件。

assets.name: Old MacDonald
assets.source_label: xiangshao-g3-1 · 文件页 57 / 印刷页 50

source_visual_review.design: Old MacDonald, elderly farmer named in song; page depicts animals and a scarecrow, not the farmer. Original design: cheerful elderly man with weathered round face, thick white moustache and eyebrows, straw hat with dark green band, red-and-cream plaid long-sleeve shirt, indigo denim overalls, brown work boots. Empty hands.
source_visual_review.constraints: Human elderly farmer, not the scarecrow. No animals, tools or hay.

assets.reason: Old MacDonald 的老年体型、草帽与背带工装适合作为农场活动常用造型。

assets.name: 红色蒸汽小火车
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 从当前块状小火车提升为清晰的机车轮廓，锅炉、驾驶室与车轮细节使用频率高。

assets.name: 海蓝旋纹贝壳
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 螺旋外壳与开口曲面有明显立体细节，适合海边拾取物。

assets.name: 暖枝小鸟巢
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 交错树枝与巢碗结构较费手工，能明显改善鸟巢场景。

assets.name: 暖光纸灯笼
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 补齐灯笼的提手、筋骨和穗，能同时服务灯笼屋与节庆活动。

assets.name: 蜜桃毛线球
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 交错毛线纹理比现有单色球更有辨识度，可用于毛线屋与收藏道具。

assets.name: 秋日小南瓜
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 保留南瓜沟槽、瓜柄和叶片，可用于农场、节庆与摆设。

assets.name: 草莓冰淇淋
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 甜筒格纹和冰淇淋表面能提升近景拾取/展示观感。

assets.name: 麦香乡村面包
assets.source_label: 互动道具
assets.reason: 面包裂纹和烘焙表面能替换现有简化几何，适合烘焙屋及餐饮场景。

assets.name: 云朵双人沙发
assets.source_label: 家具
assets.reason: 常驻室内的较大件家具，软包和云朵靠背会持续出现在画面里。

assets.name: 童话绘本架
assets.source_label: 家具
assets.reason: 常驻图书/家居场景，层架开口与弧顶具有明显视觉收益；书和抽屉后续按需拆分。

assets.name: 黄铜留声机
assets.source_label: 家具
assets.reason: 喇叭口和弯管结构独特，适合音乐场景；唱片若需旋转要另分件。

assets.name: 兔兔绿雕
assets.source_label: 家具
assets.reason: 兔形轮廓与叶簇细节能作为庭院视觉中心；与活动角色分开处理。

assets.name: 田园丝带草帽
assets.source_label: 穿戴配饰
assets.reason: 一件独立草帽可以给多位人物复用，编织材质和帽檐比重复生成人物更划算。

assets.name: 摘星画家贝雷帽
assets.source_label: 穿戴配饰
assets.reason: 一件贝雷帽可供多个发型适配，保留独立配件以减少整个人物重生成。

assets.name: 元气向日葵书包
assets.source_label: 穿戴配饰
assets.reason: 书包可供儿童角色和学校场景反复使用；背带需按角色体型校正。

assets.name: 藤编野餐花篮
assets.source_label: 穿戴配饰
assets.reason: 藤编纹理、开口和背带结构适合图生模型，并能服务采集与野餐场景。
